findings.highlight: I have to come up with a way that won’t involve Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: しばらくは顔を合わせない方がいいのだろうか
findings.governingReading: perhaps I should avoid seeing Shinji for a while
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative question about temporarily avoiding Shinji is replaced with a firm plan concerning Sakura.

findings.evidenceJa: 今日は朝から新記録
findings.governingReading: a new record first thing this morning
findings.explanation: Taiga’s morning scope is again omitted.

findings.highlight: she’s even more energetic than usual
findings.evidenceJa: いつもより元気あるじゃないか、まったく
findings.governingReading: she is more energetic than usual—honestly
findings.explanation: Shirou’s exasperated closing beat is again omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: うぐいすパンと日本茶
findings.governingReading: uguisu bean-paste bread and Japanese tea
findings.explanation: Both specific lunch items are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: そのまま最短で階段へ駆け込んだ
findings.governingReading: charged into the stairwell by the shortest route
findings.explanation: The urgency and route of Shirou’s movement are omitted.

findings.highlight: I dash to the rooftop, startling students as I go
findings.evidenceJa: 一階に下りていく生徒たちに逆走して屋上へ
findings.governingReading: I run against the flow of students descending to the first floor and head for the roof
findings.explanation: The direction of motion is removed and unsupported startled reactions are added.

findings.highlight: It’s been pounding faster and faster the whole day
findings.evidenceJa: 一時限目が終わって二時限目が終わって、三時限目が終わって四時限目が始まって、胸の動悸はおさまるどころかテンポをあげる一方だった
findings.governingReading: through the ends of first, second, and third periods and the start of fourth, the pounding only increased its tempo
findings.explanation: The accumulating class-by-class duration and rhythmic syntax are compressed into the whole day.

findings.evidenceJa: 一年の頃から憧れていた女の子なんだこんちくしょー
findings.governingReading: the girl I have admired since first year, damn it
findings.explanation: The duration of Shirou’s admiration and his embarrassed internal outburst disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 待ち合わせに遅れるなんて失態は見せられない
findings.governingReading: I cannot let her see me commit the disgraceful blunder of arriving late
findings.explanation: The social stakes Shirou assigns to lateness are reduced to punctuality.

findings.highlight: I have to get there before her and act cool
findings.evidenceJa: 余裕を見せないと、カッコつかない
findings.governingReading: I have to arrive first and display composure or I will look pathetic
findings.explanation: Composure as evidence of competence becomes generic performance of coolness.

findings.evidenceJa: 屋上に誰かが来ても見つからない
findings.governingReading: even if someone comes onto the roof, they will not be found there
findings.explanation: A concealment property under a stated contingency becomes an absolute assertion.

findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の家はもともと魔術師の家系らしいんだが
findings.governingReading: the Matou family was originally a lineage of magi—did you know
findings.explanation: The missing separation again visibly merges “magi” and “did.”

findings.highlight: He doesn’t have a Magic Circuit, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術使いとしての最低条件である魔術回路
findings.governingReading: he lacks Magic Circuits, the minimum condition even for a practitioner of Magecraft
findings.explanation: The spellcaster/magus distinction and minimum threshold are again removed.

findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の本
findings.governingReading: Shinji’s book, read as his Command Spell
findings.explanation: The base text and ruby are again rendered as separate objects.

findings.evidenceJa: それだけでも危なっかしい
findings.governingReading: that alone makes the situation precarious
findings.explanation: The unstable situation is again turned into a direct danger judgment.

findings.highlight: magic only gets taught to the successor
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術ってのは後継者にしか教えない
findings.governingReading: Magecraft is taught only to the successor
findings.explanation: Magecraft is again generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: He might take out his anger on Sakura, and there’s no telling what’ll happen if he does something even worse
findings.evidenceJa: あのままだと、一緒に住んでいる桜だって、ずっと無関係でいられるかわからない
findings.governingReading: if he remains that way, Sakura may not be able to remain uninvolved
findings.explanation: The mature branch again replaces possible involvement with an explicit abuse and escalation prediction.

findings.evidenceJa: 他の連中はどうもきな臭い
findings.governingReading: the other parties smell suspicious
findings.explanation: Suspicion of unexplained activity is again changed into tactical trickiness.

findings.evidenceJa: 戦いから降りる
findings.governingReading: give up being a Master and withdraw from the fighting
findings.explanation: Shinji’s withdrawal from the conflict is again omitted.

findings.highlight: I doubt she wants to stay at my house
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌がるに決まってる
findings.governingReading: she is certain to dislike being told to stay from today
findings.explanation: Certainty and the abrupt demand are again weakened.

findings.highlight: Just go ahead and ask her
findings.evidenceJa: ダメもとで訊いてみなさい
findings.governingReading: ask her even if you expect it to fail
findings.explanation: Rin’s practical instruction to try despite likely failure is again omitted.

findings.highlight: before I start worrying about what I think
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の気持ちを気にする前に
findings.governingReading: before I presume to worry about Sakura’s feelings
findings.explanation: The feelings are again reassigned from Sakura to Shirou.

findings.highlight: have a little confidence in yourself
findings.evidenceJa: もっと強気で桜を振り回しなさい
findings.governingReading: be more forceful and take the lead with Sakura
findings.explanation: Rin tells Shirou to assertively pull Sakura along; the English turns this into private self-confidence.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜に頼りにされてる
findings.governingReading: Sakura relies on you
findings.explanation: Dependence on Shirou’s support is softened into trust.

findings.highlight: you probably told me, you certainly told me
findings.evidenceJa: きっと言った、必ず言った
findings.governingReading: you definitely said it—without fail, you said it
findings.explanation: One of Rin’s escalating assertions of certainty is mistranslated as probability.

findings.highlight: Her quick shout stops my rebuttal
findings.evidenceJa: 一気にまくしたて、こっちの反論を打ち消す
findings.governingReading: she rattles it all off in one breath, drowning out my objection
findings.explanation: Speed and uninterrupted verbal pressure become a generic shout.

findings.evidenceJa: あの夜に嫌っていうほど思い知らされてた
findings.governingReading: that night had driven home to me more than enough
findings.explanation: The unpleasant degree and scene-specific force of Shirou learning about Rin’s school mask disappear.

findings.highlight: I would’ve taken longer to make up my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 俺一人じゃヘンに気を遣って、決めるのがもっと遅れていた
findings.governingReading: alone I would have been excessively considerate and delayed the decision further
findings.explanation: The reason for Shirou’s delay—misdirected concern for Sakura—is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: もしかしてのろけ？
findings.governingReading: are you perhaps bragging about your romance?
findings.explanation: Rin’s specific teasing suggestion that Shirou is boasting affectionately about Sakura becomes generic showing off.

findings.highlight: I only make fun of people if it’s worth doing
findings.evidenceJa: からかって楽しい相手しか手を出さない
findings.governingReading: I only go after people who are fun to tease
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission that she selects targets for the pleasure of teasing them becomes an abstract worth calculation.

findings.highlight: come closer and block the wind
findings.evidenceJa: もっと場所詰めてよ。あんまり離れると風が冷たい
findings.governingReading: move closer; the wind is cold when we sit this far apart
findings.explanation: Rin asks to close the space between them; the English makes Shirou physically block the wind for her.

findings.evidenceJa: 油断ならない知人
findings.governingReading: an acquaintance around whom I cannot let down my guard
findings.explanation: Shirou’s wary familiarity with Rin is hardened into an ominous formal relationship.

findings.evidenceJa: 女らしいふくよかな体
findings.governingReading: her full, feminine body
findings.explanation: Concrete mature fullness is replaced with an inference about softness.

findings.highlight: My heart’s pounding so hard that it feels like it’s about to explode
findings.evidenceJa: ドクドクと脈打っていた心臓が、今ではバクバクと爆発している
findings.governingReading: the heart that had been throbbing is now pounding explosively
findings.explanation: The contrast between the earlier and current intensity is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 毒気が抜かれた
findings.governingReading: you took the hostility out of me
findings.explanation: Rin says Shirou has disarmed her antagonistic mood; the English changes this to surprise.

findings.evidenceJa: 毒気が抜かれたって、なんのさ
findings.governingReading: what do you mean, I took the hostility out of you?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s follow-up repeats the same mistranslation, removing the relational change from the exchange.

findings.highlight: people who’ve been going into comas
findings.evidenceJa: 原因不明の昏睡事件
findings.governingReading: the unexplained coma incidents
findings.explanation: The lack of an identified cause is again omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 厄介な相手
findings.governingReading: a troublesome opponent
findings.explanation: Unsupported cunning again replaces broader difficulty.

findings.highlight: Well, I’m going to sit and watch for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 日に日に強くなっていくから早目に潰したいんだけど、わたしのアーチャーは誰かさんにやられた傷が治ってないしね
findings.governingReading: They are growing stronger by the day, so I want to crush them early, but Archer’s wound from a certain someone has not healed
findings.explanation: An entire active sentence establishing enemy growth, Rin’s urgency, Archer’s condition, and her jab at Shirou is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: マスターとして手を尽くしている
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is exhausting every available measure as a Master
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition specifically of Rin’s conduct as a Master is omitted and weakened.

findings.highlight: I feel like a frog in front of a snake
findings.evidenceJa: その不吉さは、カエルを前にしたヘビじみてイヤだ
findings.governingReading: its ominousness is unpleasantly like a snake before a frog
findings.explanation: The narration describes Rin’s smile as the predatory snake; the English shifts emphasis to Shirou’s subjective self-image.

findings.evidenceJa: うぐいすパン
findings.governingReading: my bread
findings.explanation: The specific uguisu bean-paste bread is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 食堂も購買も終わってる
findings.governingReading: both the cafeteria and school store are closed
findings.explanation: The second unavailable food source is omitted.
